_comment: Invrisil 8c Task C1 (issue #12) -- ~28x18 boulevard, the scale-shock map (locked shape: Liscor is a town, this is a city). biome invrisil_street: OWNED PixelLab marble/paving wang tileset + already-present Wall_Tiles cool stone facade (see biomes.json's own _comment; no NEW manifest entry, avoids the licensed-pick STOP). North/south facade bands (y in {0,1} / {16,17}) are the 'buildings loom' read; the walkable band (y 2-15) carries the marble PLAZA patch (floor_layers below) around the fountain, the lamp-row signature (8 anchors total, non-flicker gold -- the spec's exact budget), and the crowd (7 pool-less extras, locked shape 2) with the mid-street kept clear per direction.md. Reachable ONLY via the portal contract (data/portals.json's new 'invrisil' row, requires_accomplishment invrisil_attuned, banked by the Guild-board letter beat) -- no door chain from Liscor's own street, matching the riverfarm_village precedent one region further. The mercantile_alleys door is the map's own second exit (the alleys-around-fronts traversal signature).

floor_layers._pick: The marble plaza patch around the fountain -- OWNED wang tileset, pure-marble tile. CONTROLLER FIX 2026-07-08: [3,3] (row-major by wang id, id15 = pure marble), not the handoff doc's wrong [0,3] (a transition tile -- the doc's id->position table was corrected on main).

FIX WAVE facade assembly, handoff.md's recipe executed DATA-SIDE (per-cell picks; a committed composite of licensed pieces is forbidden in the public repo, and floor_layers rects accept negative y -- verified in tile_board_builder.resolve_layer_cells, plain range(), no grid clamp -- so the above-grid loom rows need no code). Layer 1/5: the cornice/roofline cap, Wall_Tiles (8,2) cool blue-grey stone (picks.md sec.2, MOCKUP-PROVEN), one row above the visible plaster at y=-2.

Layer 2/5: cream plaster upper floors, Building_Walls (26,2) (picks.md sec.1, MOCKUP-PROVEN flat #ddccb8) -- y=-1 (above-grid loom row) + y=0 (in-grid blocked row, cover_skip'd). Two plaster rows over a glass row = the 2-cell-facade scale-shock read, plus the cornice above.

Layer 3/5: the leaded-glass storefront line, Building_Walls (13,35) (picks.md sec.1, MOCKUP-PROVEN, 'USE SPARINGLY -- one shopfront band') -- exactly one band, the ground-floor row y=1 the player walks past.

Layer 4/5: pilaster strips every 3 cells (the spec's 'vertical LINES'), Wall_Tiles (8,2) stone columns spanning y=-1..1. Full 16px cells, not the mockup's 6px strips -- the cell-pick machinery has no sub-cell crop, so each pilaster is a full stone column dividing the glass line into 2-cell shopfronts (an honest approximation the windowed re-take judges).

Layer 5/5: the south band (y 16-17) -- building BACKS/rooftops seen from the street's north side, textured masonry variant Wall_Tiles (8,17) (picks.md sec.2's darker band) instead of the flat cool slab the windowed read flagged. Roofline texture, not facade (their fronts face away).

entities._comment: Invrisil 8c Task C1 (issue #12) -- the anchor-stone-per-region idiom's newest end (data/portals.json's new 'invrisil' row). Playtest hotfix #6: sprite swapped `boulder` -> `anchor_waystone` (a bespoke waystone-archway silhouette, not a rock) -- the entity's OWN toast copy already foreshadowed this ('the frame of light waiting just under the surface'), so the swap makes the art match the text that was already there. CONSTRAINT: NO new `light` here -- this map's 8 `street_lamp` decor entries already sit at the hard 8-light-per-map budget (WIWorld._rebuild_field's assertion, spec §5); a 9th light hard-fails the map build. Every other anchor site got a stronger/steady light; this one gets the sprite-only fix. If a future pass wants the glow here too, it has to trade off one of the 8 lamps first, not just add a 9th light.
entities.toast: A plain grey stone, out of place against the marble -- until you notice the coin-gold vein running through it, and the frame of light waiting just under the surface.
entities.observe: The Liscor stones were rougher. This one has been handled by people with better manners; it barely shows the wear.

Invrisil 8c Task C1 (NPC surface) + Task C3 issue #13 (this edit -- wires `conversation`). Voice lifted from docs/design/dialogue-drafts/invrisil/merchant_prince.json's register (prices everything, never raises his voice). C3's own graph (data/dialogue/invrisil_merchant_prince.json, recast merchant_blades->hired_blades + exposed/extorted_merchant_prince->merchant_exposed/merchant_extorted at wiring time -- see that file's own _comment) now lands, matching the Lyonette/Krshia precedent for a pool-then-conversation NPC: interact()'s `npc` branch plays the FIRST talk of a waking from `talk_pool` (unchanged), then routes every later talk that same waking into `conversation` -- both surfaces stay live, none of the pre-quest flavor is orphaned. Sprite: reused `pc_human_m` rig tinted cream/gold (coin-gold-on-a-person, per character-profiles-staging.md's 'the city's accent hue ON a person' tell) -- zero new generation.
entities.observe: Coin-gold trim on a merchant's collar, rings enough to case a fist. He totals you before you've said a word — cheaply, by the look on his face.
entities.friendly_line: He offers a smile with the price tag still visible on the underside. "Charming," he allows, in the tone of a man crossing an item off a ledger.
talk_pool: New face. I do like a new face — they're cheap, and occasionally they appreciate into something useful.
Everything has a price. The trick, which so few of you learn, is finding out whose.
Do step out of the doorway. You're blocking a view I paid a great deal to own.

entities._comment: GH#68 (Invrisil quest-stage rework): Stage 1's SHARED scouting beat -- 'A Gentleman's Disagreement' no longer resolves off Wilovan's brief alone; the player has to actually walk the city and place Coyle's operation before any evidence path opens up. Plain on_interact_accomplishment (no skill gate -- 'cheap but real', reachable by every build/path). Sprite reused (`crate`, the merchant-city decor idiom already established by the alley's own stacked-goods dressing) -- zero new generation. Cell (18,13): south band, off invrisil_walkthrough's own pinned route (that canonical's re-pathed BEAT 3 detours here explicitly; see that script's own comment) and off every entity cell on this map.
entities.observe: Stacked shipping crates, waist-high, the kind of cover a man leans on to watch a street without looking like he's watching it.
entities.toast: You circle the block twice before it clicks: the modest COYLE AND SONS sign out front doesn't match the two wagons idling round the side, or the men counting crates like men who've been shorted before. Whatever Coyle's really running out of, the front door is the least of it.

entities._comment: GH#68 (Invrisil quest-stage rework): the FIGHT path's Stage 2 tailing chain, first leg. Plain on_interact_accomplishment, no skill gate -- fielding a fighter-built PC must never require an [Appraise Foe]/observe investment to reach a fight. Pairs with `warehouse_approach`'s second leg (mercantile_alleys) to bank `warehouse_located`, the counter `invrisil_wilovan.json`'s `fists_door` come-along ask now gates on. Sprite reused (`food_basket`, the market-stall idiom already used for bread_stall/krshia_stall) -- zero new generation. Cell (20,13): south band, clear of every pinned route and entity on this map (this prop is FIGHT-path-only, exercised via teleport in near_invrisil_fight/invrisil_disagreement_fight, never walked by the shared invrisil_walkthrough canonical).
entities.observe: A runner ducks out Coyle's side door with a ledger under one arm, moving with the particular haste of someone who'd rather not be noticed leaving.
entities.toast: You fall in a comfortable distance behind. The runner doesn't loop, doesn't double back -- just walks like a man with somewhere specific to be, heading for the alleys off the boulevard's east end.

EXISTING combatants only (footpad_lookout/footpad_bruiser -- the SAME low-lethality pair alley_footpads_a/b already field) on the EXISTING mercantile_alley arena (no new arena). No ally (matches alley_footpads_a/b's own solo convention -- nobody's fielded on the open boulevard at night). encounter_when{phase:[night]} + trigger_radius 1 + respawns:true, river_wolf_pack's exact shape. visual_states hides the marker outside night. PLACEMENT: (13,15) in the boulevard's south band (y14-15), the ONE stretch of this heavily-trafficked map (invrisil_walkthrough/invrisil_disagreement_*'s pinned routes/teleports/the y=2 phase-grind sweep all stay within y2-13) verified empty of every entity/pinned coordinate those canonicals touch -- Chebyshev distance to the nearest real entity (coyle_runner_trail, 20,13) is 7; nothing on this map's own row y14/y15 is ever walked or teleported to by any shipped script.
